name: Dr. Laura Duncanson
title: Associate Professor
bio1: Laura is a remote sensing scientist whose research centres on mapping and understanding forest 3-D structure using novel spaceborne technologies. She leads GEDI algorithm development for forest aboveground biomass density and serves on NASA's ICESat-2 and ABoVE science teams, developing methods for boreal forest mapping toward global carbon accounting.
bio2: She is a co-lead of CEOS's Land Product Validation Biomass sub-group — working toward consistent international protocols for global biomass product calibration and validation. Her group tests ecological theory with remote sensing, exploring linkages between forest structure and biodiversity in protected areas worldwide.
education: PhD · University of Maryland | MSc · University of Victoria | BSc Honours · Queen's University
expertise: LiDAR Remote Sensing · Forest Biomass · Data Fusion · Forest Ecology

name: Mengyu Liang
bio1: Research focuses on quantifying aboveground biomass dynamics in Africa using GEDI LiDAR combined with Landsat time series. Led the Mozambique charcoal degradation study.

name: Hao Tang
bio1: GEDI postdoctoral researcher characterizing 3D dynamics of terrestrial ecosystems across multiple lidar platforms. PhD from UMD; NASA Earth & Space Science Fellow 2012–2015.

name: João A. Silva
bio1: Co-investigator on African forest degradation projects. Contributes expertise in tropical forest monitoring and biomass estimation in data-scarce regions.

name: Fernando Sedano
bio1: Remote sensing scientist focusing on land cover change and forest disturbance in sub-Saharan Africa. Partner on the GEDI-Landsat Mozambique project.
expertise: Land Cover Change · Forest Disturbance · Africa

name: Veronika Leitold

name: Temilola Fatoyinbo

name: Anuradha Swatantran

name: Amanda Whitehurst
